faqs.q: What is Anchor Line Hook used for?
faqs.a: Anchor Line Hook is a hook for recovering a mooring line from the seabed, rated by safe working load in tonnes. It is listed in 6 sizes, 15 t SWL to 80 t SWL.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Anchor Line Hook, such as IH-MR-AH-ALH-15T?
faqs.a: Anchor Line Hook part numbers begin with IH-MR-AH-ALH and end in a size code: IH-MR-AH-ALH-15T is the 15 t SWL size and IH-MR-AH-ALH-80T is the 80 t SWL size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does Anchor Line Hook come in?
faqs.a: Anchor Line Hook is listed in 6 sizes, 15 t SWL to 80 t SWL, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-MR-AH-ALH-15T and IH-MR-AH-ALH-80T. The table includes 15 t SWL: minimum breaking load 60 t, WLL 15 t, proof load 30 t and 80 t SWL: minimum breaking load 320 t, WLL 80 t, proof load 160 t.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Anchor Line Hook?
faqs.a: For Anchor Line Hook, state the SWL and the chain or wire size the tool works on. The SWL must be at least the working tension on the line being handled, and should be checked against the work wire and the vessel's winch pull.

faqs.q: What SWL does Anchor Line Hook have?
faqs.a: Anchor Line Hook is listed with a 15 to 80 t working load, depending on size. The size table also gives a proof load of 30 to 160 t. The WLL or SWL is the most the tool may carry in service; proof and breaking loads are test figures, never working limits.

faqs.q: What material and finish is Anchor Line Hook supplied in?
faqs.a: The listing for Anchor Line Hook does not state the material or the finish. Tell us the environment it will work in and any material standard or coating you need, and we confirm what the maker can supply before you order.

faqs.q: What standard and documents apply to Anchor Line Hook?
faqs.a: The listing for Anchor Line Hook names no standard and no certificate. If your project needs a particular standard, a material certificate or a classification-society or inspection document, state it on the RFQ and we confirm what can be supplied before you order.

faqs.q: What does Anchor Line Hook connect to or work with?
faqs.a: Anchor Line Hook is used with work wire, pendant wire, chain and rated shackles of the same capacity. Mooring chain and its connectors are on the [anchor chain accessories shelf](/c/anchor-chain-accessories) and anchors on the [marine anchors shelf](/c/marine-anchors).

faqs.q: How should Anchor Line Hook be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: Check Anchor Line Hook for wear on the throat and bearing surfaces, cracks, bent parts and pin wear after every job, and take it out of service if it is damaged. Offshore lifting equipment also needs periodic examination by a competent person.

faqs.q: How does Anchor Line Hook differ from J-Lock Chaser — Single Chain Grabber?
faqs.a: Anchor Line Hook differs from [J-Lock Chaser — Single Chain Grabber](/p/j-lock-chaser-single-chain-grabber) in its size range 15 t SWL to 80 t SWL against 110 t WLL to 250 t WLL; working load limit 15–80 t against 110–250 t.

faqs.a: Yes. We ship Anchor Line Hook from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.a: Yes, Anchor Line Hook is held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the sizes and quantities you need through [our contact page](/contact).
